mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs fall.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by 0.1% or more.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise by >1% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles, defined by rising FEDFUNDS, reduce liquidity and increase borrowing costs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production signals weakening economic activity, reducing corporate profit margins and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls by >0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts rising more than 1% monthly indicates strengthening housing market momentum, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST rises by >1% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate increases (UNRATE) indicate labor market instability, raising economic uncertainty and causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS grows but UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100.0 signals economic slowdown, reducing corporate investment and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0.
